tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs sprin phung zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zas gtsang sras po mnyes pa'i gsung skyes mchog /kun dga' bo zhes nges don rdo rje 'dzin/ /bsil ldan ljongs 'dir kun dga' bzang po zhes/ /lung bstan skyes bu mchog de bstod par bgyi/ /mgon khyod nges don ston bsdud dbyer med phyir/ /rtogs brjod kun mkhyen kho na'i spyod yul las/ /sar gnas sems dpas rtogs par mi 'gyur na/ /byol song yid can bdag 'dras ci zhig 'tshal/ /khyod kyi zhal gyi bdud rtsi legs gsol ba'i/ /lha tshogs brgyud par bcas pa'i mkhas rnams kyis/ /bstod tshogs dbyar rngas stong gsum 'gengs mthong nas/ /bdag yid gdengs can sar nas 'di spros so/ /kun khyab zab gsal gnyis med chos kyi sku/ /dga' chen yan lag bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ /bzang po'i phrin las bsam yas sprul pa'i sku/ /'og min zhing gi dpal gyur khyod phyag 'tshal/ /grangs med bskal pa'i sngon du byang chub kyang / /'jig rten mgon dang gsang ba'i bdag po sogs/ /rgyal ba'i myu gu nye sras tshul 'dzin sogs/ /thos sgrogs ngur smrig 'dzin par sprul la 'dud/ /gang la gang 'dul sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar/ /srid mtha'i bar du rgyun mi chad pas na/ /de mtha' 'di zhes khyab mtha' su yis 'dzin/ /bsam mi khyab pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'on kyang 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can 'dir/ /gnas lnga rig pa bslab gsum rgyan phreng can/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag skyes chen rab mang du/ /sprul pa'i phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyad par zhing 'dir rigs bzang gzhon nu nas/ /rgyal ba dges pa'i bslab gsum lang tsho la/

/yongs 'dzin rnams kyi spyan gyis 'bras ltar 'tsho/ /yongs rdzogs bstan la dbang bsgyur khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ci nus klog spong las kyi 'khor lo dang / /sems gnyis yid nor thabs shes btsun mo'i dngos/ /blo yi nor 'chang khyim bdag theg chen glang / /myur 'gro go cha rin chen bdun sogs 'bul/ /rang gzhan bcas rang nyes kun bshags shing sdom/ /'khor 'das dus gsum dge la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor bskul mya ngan mi 'da' gsol/ /dge tshogs bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /da ni yid kyi 'phyang mo'i cha 'ga' zhig /zhu ba 'di la yin min nges pa'i cha/ /ring por mi 'gyangs srid 'dir gsal gyur nas/ /dpyod ldan blo la nges pa'i dpal ster mdzod/ /dam pa'i ring lugs yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i khur/ /phal cher nub nas ming gi lhag ma tsam/ 'dzin pa la la khe rnyed 'du 'dzi dang / /la la de med kun gyi brnyas pa'i gzhi/ /'di 'dra'i dus su nges don gdams pa'i bcud/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i nges gsang bdud rtsi'i thig /'dzin pa gang la khyod zhal nyams rmi lam/ /bstan nas dbugs dbyung dus bab 'dren dbang kye/ /da lta nyam thag 'di 'drar mi gzigs na/ /tshogs lam cher gnas sogs kyis mthong zhes pa/ /de tshe 'byor dus gnyen gyi dpe ji bzhin/ /gnas tshul de la bdag cag som nyir mchis/ /'on kyang rnam pa kun tu khyod nyid las/ /skyabs gzhan med par mos pa rtse gcig par/ /khyod kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rnam rol gyis/ /don gnyis phun tshogs dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /zhes pa 'di rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dus chen gyis mchod pa'i dus du dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis gsol ba btab pa'o/ /sarba maṅgā laṃ// ༈ /yan lag bdun pa phul ba'i tshigs bcad bzhugs so// swa sti/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang / /dkon mchog rnam gsum chos srung nor lha'i tshogs/ /phyag 'os kun la bdag dang sems can kun/

/sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /kun nas mchod cing sdig bshags dge yid rang / /chos 'khor bskor zhing bskal brgyar bzhugs su gsol/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa ci mchis rnams/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /de lta'i rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob bar/ /dal 'byor dge mtshan ldan pa'i lus thob nas/ /dkon mchog skyabs brnyes dam pas rjes bzung ste/ /rgyal sras spyod tshul rgya mtsho spyod par shog /tshe 'dir bdag la glo snying brang gsum gyis/ /'di phyi'i rkyen sel 'dren ltos re ba rnams/ /gnas skabs chos mthun dge tshogs rnam par 'phel/ /mthar thug rdzogs byang 'bras bu thob par shog /khyad par dmigs yul tshe 'das bgrang yas kyi/ /sdig sgrib bag chags bcas pa kun byang nas/ /theg chen sa lam rim pa legs bgrod de/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog /gang dag bdag la gshe bar byed pa dang / /srog gi bar du 'tshe ba byed na'ang / /de la brten nas sdig par mi 'gyur zhing / /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bzod pa mthar phyin shog /'jig rten bde zhing 'byor pa phun sum tshogs/ /tshe ring nad med chos la blo kha phyogs/ /chos don yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel te/ /phun tshogs rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /bdag gi tshe 'di'i gnas skabs thams cad du'ang / /rang don yid byed dman pa'i sems spangs te/ /lhag bsam rnam dag 'dod don kun 'grub nas/ /zag med bde chen gling du 'gro bar shog /ces dkon mchog gsum la 'dod don zhu ba'i tshigs bcad 'di dkon mchog gi bka' 'bangs su gnas pa buddha lakṣi ngor chen rdo rje 'chang sogs skyes chen du ma'i dus chen zla ba bzhi pa'i nyer lnga la bris te kha 'don du byas pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /a ho/ ngo mtshar dpag par dka' ba'i sangs rgyas bstan/ /gangs can 'dir yang dam pas rgyas mdzad kyang / /da ni lnga bdo'i shugs drag lhags dus 'dir/

/thar lam mi 'tshol sems ldan de ci 'dra/ /zhes so// ༈ /bla ma la gsol 'debs phur tshugs bzhugs so// rgyal ba kun dngos dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas gang / /gang gi rang bzhin bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan lhar bcas 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog /mchog gi bla mar sgo gsum gus pa chen pos 'dud/ /'dud bstod mchod sogs rlabs chen yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ /de ltar skyabs kun ngo bo bla ma la/ /dad pa gsum gyi yan lag bdun pa'i mthus/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes rnams rtag rgyas shog /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'khri shing drwa ba kun/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i mtshon gyis legs bcad de/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i mthu ldan shog /gang dag bdag la kun tu ltos bcas rnams/ /gang yang bdag la skyobs nus ma mchis pas/ /gang phyir dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /gang rnams mngon mtho nges legs gnas thob shog /rab mchog thub pa'i bstan pa'i snying po ni/ /rab tu bla ma'i mos gus zhes gsungs kyang / /rab mgyogs 'jig rten zas nor rjes 'gro ba'i/ /rab dman bdag la dad pa'i rlan skye shog /ces bla ma la phur tshugs su bya bral sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis gsol ba btab pa'o// ༈ /mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan la bstod pa bzhugs so// rnam dkar tshogs gnyis goms pa'i legs byas mthus/ /dri med bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag tu/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las dpal mnga' ba/ /rdo rje gsum dngos ldan pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa 'di rje chos rje bkra shis rgya mtshos bskul ngor dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bris pa'o// ༈ /shar pa ye shes bzang po la bstod pa bzhugs so// swa sti/ ye shes dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i rta ljang gis/ /rnam dpyod brtson pa'i mkha' la legs drangs nas/ /phan bde'i pad tshal ma lus rgyas mdzad pa/

/phrin las bzang po 'jam dbyangs bla mar 'dud/ /ces rje shar pa ye shes bzang po la bstod pa 'di yang btsun pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so// ༈ /shar pa ye shes bzang po khu dbon la brtan bzhugs phul ba'i tshigs bcad// oṃ swa sti/ rab mchog bsod nams rin chen khams las grub/ /rab zab ye shes rgya mtshor mngon par brjid/ /rab mang gdul bya gling bzhi'i lte 'dzin dbang / /rab mkhas phrin las bzang po rgyal gyur cig /bskal bzang sangs rgyas bzhi pa'i ring lugs mchog /mchog tu bstan 'dzin phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gnas bzhi chos grwa 'o ma'i rgya mtsho che/ /ches cher rgyas pa'i phrin las bzang por shog /rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin bla ma yab sras sogs/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i go sgrub rnams/ /yid srub byed po'i phyogs las rnam rgyal nas/ /gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde'i sgo 'byed shog /rig 'dzin tshe dang rnam thos 'byor pa dang / /klog spong bya ba las kyi 'khor lo sogs/ /bstan dang sems can bde ba'i phrin las rnams/ /rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i sprin bzhin rgyas par shog /dngos brgyud bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje dang / /bstan srung nor lha'i tshogs kyi mthu dpal dang / /chos nyid 'gyur med rten 'brel bslu med mthus/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub gyur cig /ces shar chen ye shes bzang po khu dbon gyi brtan bzhugs bden tshig brjod rgyur phrin las dpal 'bar zhes bya ba 'di rgyal khams kyi dā ri dra pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ /mkhan chen shes rab rgya mtsho'i brtan bzhugs// shes bya'i lha lam ngos yangs par/ /rab gsal mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /phan bde rgya mtsho 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa'i dpal du brtan gyur cig /ces kun mkhyen gnyis pa bu ston rin po che'i rgyal tshab thar rtse nas mkhan chen shes rab rgya mtsho'i brtan bzhugs su dge slong snyoms las pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis brjod pa'o//

༈ /bla ma dam pa phun tshogs rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad// na mo gu ru we/ phun tshogs tshogs gnyis mthar phyin skyabs kun gtso/ /rdo rje rje btsun mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /yongs grags grags dkar mi bzad 'byung ba'i sgo/ /dpal bzang bzang po bka' drin che la 'dud/ /mgon po khyod kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu yis/ /rgyun chad med par rtag tu skyabs na yang / /ring mo'i bar du gnas tshul shes ma gyur/ /da ni bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la zhugs/ /snang srid 'di kun mthun rkyen grogs su shar/ /snang stong zung 'jug rten 'brel gsang ba cher/ /nges pa gting nas rnyed pa'i dga' ston 'di/ /mar gyur bgrang yas 'gro la ston par shog /ces pa 'di ni gzhon nu'i dus gcod yul la sogs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyis yongs su bzung ba'i bla ma nyams dang rtogs pa'i dbang phyug phun tshogs rdo rje grags pa dpal bzang po de nyid kyi bka' drin shin tu che bar go zhing byin rlabs sems la zhugs pa'i mtshan ma mthong ma thag me pho stag lo zla ba dang po'i yar tshes bcu'i dus bzang la dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis shugs 'byung du gsol ba btab pa'o// ༈ /mkhas btsun kun legs la bstod pa// swa sti/ kun nas dga' bzhi brnyes pa'i snying po'i don/ /legs byas bsod nams mchog gi rtser son dang / /rnam dkar grags pa'i rgya mtshan 'dzin pa sogs/ /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang sku mkhas btsun bzang po'i chu 'dzin las/ /gang gsung 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'brug sgra sgrog /gang thugs mkhyen brtse nus pa'i char rgyun gyis/ /gang zhig gdul bya'i lo thog smin la 'dud/ /dge ba 'di dang 'khor 'das legs byas kun/ /ma lus blo yis gcig tu sdom pa'i mthus/ /gnas skabs 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /mngon mtho nges legs dpal gyi 'byor par shog /ces mkhas btsun dam pa kun dga' legs pa la bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dra pa buddha'i ming can gyis phul ba'o//

༈ /bla ma dam pa dam chos bsam grub la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad bzhugs// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag dam pa mchog /chos tshul rgya mtsho mi zad 'byung ba'i sgo/ /gdul bya rgya mtsho'i bsam pa 'grub mdzad pa'i/ /phan bde rgya tsho'i gter chen khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gsang gsum 'khor lo'i mgon po he ru ka /ngur smrig chu 'dzin gar gyi rnam rol las/ /smin grol zil mngar bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyis/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i gdung sel khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i rigs bdag bla ma la/ /gsol btab dge dang dus gsum dge tshogs kyis/ /mtha' yas srid zhi'i gdung ba kun bsal nas/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig /zhes e waṃ chos ldan gyi zur chen rje bla ma dam chos bsam 'grub las 'khor lo bde mchog lo nag sogs kyi bka' drin thob pa dran nas dge slong sangs rgyas ming can gyi bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel/ deng sang mi mang po rigs rus dang grags pa gang che dang zas nor gyi phan cha gang che mchog tu 'dzin pa ma gtogs chos kyi bka' drin la bsam mkhan shin tu dkon par snang ngo // ༈ /bla ma dam ba kun dga' dpal 'byor la bstod pa bzhugs so// swa sti/ rnam dag tshul khrims kun dga'i khang bzang cher/ /rnam mang thos bsam sgom pa'i nor gyis phyug /rnam dkar phrin las dpal 'byor kun stsol ba'i/ /rnam mkhyen 'dren mchog dam pa de la 'dud/ /ces e waṃ chos ldan gyi dbu mdzad shar mi nyag gi ston pa kun dga' dpal 'byor la bstod pa dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so// ༈ /khams ston sangs rgyas dpal bzang la bstod pa bzhugs so// swa sti/ sangs rgyas bstan rtsa so thar rab brtan zhing / /byang sems sdom pa'i yal 'dab rab tu rgyas/ /rig 'dzin gsang sngags 'bras bu'i dpal gyi ljid/ /don gnyis dpag bsam bzang po la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes khams ston chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang la bstod pa 'di yang snyoms las pas so//

༈ /rang bstod bzhugs// swa sti/ mkhyen rab 'od kyi ma rig mun sangs shing / /brtse chen thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yi/ /nus pa phun tshogs thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gnyen/ /dge legs 'od stong ldan pa de la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma mchog rnams kyis/ /phun tshogs mkhyen brtse nus pas legs bzung pas/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i dpal la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /mang thos ngur smrig gos can de la 'dud/ /'dis mtshon dge tshogs ma lus gcig bsdus pas/ /lhan skyes blo yi mun pa rab sangs nas/ /yang dag don gyi snang ba rab rgyas te/ /don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog /ces 'di dbang zhus dad ldan 'gas/ /bskul ngor sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis/ /e waṃ gtsug lag khang du bris/ /'di ni snyan ngag bstan bcos las/ /sgro btags byi ba glang chen bzhin/ /yin no rang bzhin rgyan gyis dben/ /dpyod ldan rnams kyis de dgongs mdzod/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rang bstod kha skong bzhugs// dge legs kun 'byung sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /phan dgos lhag bsam phun tshogs dpal yon can/ /sku tshe brtan zhing bshad sgrub gong 'phel nas/ /rdo rje gsum dngos ngo bo mngon gyur shog /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i byin rlabs dang / /chos nyid mi 'gyur rten 'brel bslu med mthus/ /ji lhar smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /ces rang nyid kyi ring 'tshor mang pos bskul ba'i ngor bya bral ba sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so/ /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /shar pa sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin la stod pa// oṃ swa sti/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying po sdom gsum gyi/ /bcud 'dzin phan bde'i 'byung gnas rin po che/ /dpal ldan byang chub sems kyi rdo rje dngos/ /'phrin las bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya chen tshogs gnyis sngon bsags 'bras bus mchog /rigs rus mngon mtho gtsang ma'i sku brnyes nas/

/shes ldan gzu bor gnas pa'i rdo rje 'chang / /dpal ldan chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i shes rgyud smin pa dang / /bstan 'gro'i dge legs mi nyams rgyas pa dang / /mthar thug thams cad gzigs pa thob par shog /ces shar chen pa sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin gzhan don la dgongs pa'i tshe/ gdan rabs chos spyod kyi kha skong du snyom las pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi dpal e waṃ chos ldan dus sug bris so/ /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /shar pa sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin la bstod pa bzhugs// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje gar gyi dbang / /rgyal ba'i lung bstan rje btsun e waṃ pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin mchog gyur phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dpal ldan 'phrin las bzang po rtag brtan shog /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe rab brtan zhing / /rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par ring lugs 'di/ /srid mtha'i bar du mi nyams rgyas pa dang / /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus rgyas par shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha/ /mthu ldan chos srung nor lha'i byin rlabs dang / /chos nyid mi 'gyur rten 'brel bslu med mthus/ /ji ltar bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par shog /ces shar chen sangs rgyas brtan 'dzin phan bde'i 'byung gnas dpal bzang po la bstod pa bha danta buddha lakṣis so// ༈ /mkhan chen shes bya bzang po la bstod pa bzhugs// mkhas kun dga' mdzad 'dren pa bzang po yis/ /ring lugs shes byar phrin las bzang po'i phul/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpal du rab brtan zhing / /rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las rgyas gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang spo 'bor dge slong dkon mchog phun tshogs kyis bskul nas sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi bris pa'o// ༈ /rang nyid dang mkhan chen shes bya bzang po la bstod pa brtan bzhugs bcas bzhugs// mtha' yas shes byar mun sangs blo gros rgyas/ /bzang po'i 'phrin las phun tshogs gdul bya'i dpal/

/bstan dang bstan 'dzin de 'degs bcas pa kun/ /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa rang gi ming dang bsres nas bstod pa 'di'ang rang dang gdan sa pa gnyis char ring 'tshor sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bris pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /bla ma kun dga' rin chen gyi brtan gzhug bzhugs so// swa sti/ rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /bdag gis smon gnas yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /kun dga'i yongs 'dzin phan bde'i rin chen gter/ /zhabs pad brtan zhing 'phrin las rgyas gyur cig /bdag sogs ltos par bcas pa'i gdul bya rnams/ /gnas skabs rgyal bas sngags pa'i mthun rkyen tshang / /ye shes tshogs dang lhan cig 'khor lo bcus/ dge bcu la zer/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang thob par shog /dam pa kun dga' rin chen pa'i brtan bzhugs 'dod don gsol btab dang bcas pa 'di dge slong sangs rgyas bzang pos bskul nas bha danta buddha lakṣis e waṃ nas phul/ bkra shis// ༈ /chos rje shes rab don bzang la bstod pa bzhugs so// shes bya'i mkha' la rab gsal dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /nges don snang bas blo gsal dga' ston 'gyed/ /'phrin las bzang po mtha' yas gdul bya'i dpal/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bya bral burdhas bgyis so// ༈ /gser mdog chos grwa'i mkhan por bstod pa// dri med tshul khrims bstan pa yangs pa'i gzhir/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i brtson 'grus go cha can/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i dge tshogs rab rgyas pa'i/ /rang gzhan don gnyis phun tshogs de la 'dud/ /kun mkhyen shākya'i ring lugs dri ma med/ /tshul gnas shes rab gsum gyi byi dor gyis/ /phan bde'i 'od brgya 'phro ba'i dpal 'bar bas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis phun tshogs de la 'dud/ /'dis mtshon dge bas shes rab snang ba rgyas/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / /bsam don chos dang mthun pa legs grub ste/

/rang gzhan don gnyis phun tshogs bkra shis shog /ces gnas lnga rig pa'i panḍi ta chen po shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros kyi bsti gnas chos grwa chen po thub bstan gser mdog can gyi gdan sa pa mkhan chen brtson 'grus phun tshogs dang / shākya phun tshogs la bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa zhig dgos zhes dam pa de nyid kyi chos las skyes pa'i sras/ chos sde chen po dpal 'khor bde chen gyi mngon dga' grwa tshang gi gdan rnying pa chos rje shes rab phun tshogs pa'i gsung gis bskul nas snyom las pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi chos grwa chen po dpal e waṃ chos ldan du smras pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen shes rab rin chen la bstod pa bzhugs// rnam dag khrims ldan shes rab rnam gsum gyis/ /legs sbyangs dam chos rin chen dbang gi rgyal/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub mdzad de la 'dud/ /'dis mtshon dge tshogs dpal gyi lam chen pos/ /bdag cag dpon slob bsam don chos bzhin 'grub/ /mar gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /mngon mtho nges par legs pa'i lam 'jug shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis dpal gyis gzigs/ /mchog gsum bkra shis thugs rje'i sprin bsdus nas/ /don gnyis bkra shis phun tshogs lo tog rgyas/ /mthar thug bkra shis kun gzigs thob par shog /dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pa shes rab rin chen la bstod cing 'dod don gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa dgos/ zhes dge slong kun dga' bsod nams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ bya bral sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis dpal e waṃ chos ldan nas bod chen gyi sa'i char phul pa'o/ /dza yantu// ༈ /bla ma gnam kha'u pa la gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad// swa sti/ dpal ldan gnyan lo'i thugs sras grub dbang mchog /gnyan mgon dbang bskur gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i bdag

/snyan grags srid gsum khyab pa'i kha'u pa/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'di yang gnas mchog kha'u'i brag rdzong du dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis gsol ba btab pa'o// ༈ /bā ri lo tsā ba la gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad// swa sti/ tshogs gnyis sngon goms 'dod lhas rjes su bzung / /skad gnyis smra ba gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal/ /'dir tshig drug chad lo tsā ba/ /rin chen grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di yang rje de nyid kyi gnas mchog dpal g.yur mkhar mo'i gtsug lag khang du dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so// ༈ /bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis la zhabs brtan phul pa'i tshigs bcad// oṃ swa sti/ ngag dbang kun gzigs zur phud lnga pa'i gar/ /dga' chen he ru ka dpal rdo rje 'chang / /bkra shis lhar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon mchog /grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal 'byor bzang po rgyal/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje dang / /khyad par myur ma dpa' mo'i nus mthu yis/ /skyabs kun rtsa ba 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal/ /bskal brgyar zhabs brtan 'phrin las rgyas gyur cig /bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa/ /lha babs 'khon gyi gdung rigs 'phel rgyas shing / /phrin las ba dan dkar po rab bskyod pas/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan cing / gdung sras rin po che 'byon par gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di/ shākya dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis dpal e waṃ chos ldan du bris nas/ me pho byi lo gsar pa shar ba'i tshe/ yar tshes kyi dga' ba dang po la dpal sa skyar/ kho bo cag ngor khri thog pa dang bcas pa/ mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab ste/ legs 'bul gyi rten 'brel dang bcas te phul ba dza yantu/
